title: Petrolina AEK sweep Keravnos to secure OPAP BL title
description: AEK Larnaca - Keravnos 99-94 Petrolina AEK outlasted Keravnos in an overtime tonight and therefore swept the championship series. AEK Larnaca made 26-of-34 free shots (76.5 percent) during the game. 26 personal fouls committed by Keravnos helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The best player for the winners was American Amir Bell (193-1996, college: Princeton) who scored 38 points (!!!). His fellow American import guard Taveion Hollingsworth (188-1999, college: WKU) chipped in 30 points. At the other side the best for losing team was American guard Josh Hagins (187-1994, college: UALR, agency: Haylett Sports) who recorded a double-double by scoring 24 points, 7 rebounds and 10 assists and the former international point guard Filippos Tigkas (184-2002) added 33 points (!!!) and 5 rebounds respectively.
